title: Multiple Sry genes in the Okinawa spiny rat encode proteins with an A-to-S substitution in the HMG domain that retain DNA-binding ability.
authors: Urunanont, Puntakarn; Mizushima, Shusei; Uchida, Takeshi; Ishimori, Koichiro; Matiz-Ceron, Luisa; Kuroiwa, Asato
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合结构预测、DNA对接模拟与实验验证，分析冲绳刺鼠SRY蛋白HMG结构域A-to-S替换对DNA结合能力的影响，属于蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，但对象为SRY而非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以结构预测和实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: The mammalian sex-determining gene SRY is highly conserved across species, with only a few exceptions. The Japanese rodent genus Tokudaia is known for its unique sex chromosome evolution. The Okinawa spiny rat T. muenninki (TMU) acquired neo-sex chromosomes with multiple Sry copies by sex chromosome-autosome fusions. All SRY copies in TMU have a substitution from alanine to serine at position 21 in the high-mobility group (HMG) box, a critical DNA-binding domain, suggesting that they are nonfunctional. However, the sex determination system in TMU remains unclear, in part because the species is endangered and it is therefore extremely difficult to obtain experimental samples. In this study, we performed in silico and in vitro analyses to investigate the molecular properties and function of SRY using recently obtained whole-genome sequence and RNA-seq data. A comparison of SRY sequences from 225 species showed that TMU is the only species with a substitution at the 21st position. This result highlights the rarity and specificity of this substitution. Structural predictions, DNA docking simulations, electrophoretic mobility shift assays and fluorescence anisotropy showed that although the affinity was slightly lower than that of the mouse homolog, DNA-binding ability was retained. However, Sry expression was not detected in the testis, liver or brain in adult TMU. The complete absence of Sry expression in the adult tissues, despite an intact sequence, strongly indicates a loss of regulatory function. These findings provide insight into the unique evolution of the Sry gene in this species.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物性别决定基因SRY在物种间高度保守，仅有少数例外。日本啮齿类动物属Tokudaia以其独特的性染色体进化而闻名。冲绳刺鼠T. muenninki (TMU)通过性染色体-常染色体融合获得了带有多个Sry拷贝的新性染色体。TMU中所有SRY拷贝在高迁移率族（HMG）盒（一个关键的DNA结合域）的第21位均发生了从丙氨酸到丝氨酸的替换，表明它们可能无功能。然而，TMU的性别决定系统仍不清楚，部分原因在于该物种濒危，因此获取实验样本极为困难。在本研究中，我们利用最近获得的全基因组序列和RNA-seq数据，进行了计算机模拟和体外分析，以探究SRY的分子特性和功能。对225个物种的SRY序列比较显示，TMU是唯一在第21位发生替换的物种。这一结果突显了该替换的稀有性和特异性。结构预测、DNA对接模拟、电泳迁移率变动分析和荧光各向异性实验表明，尽管亲和力略低于小鼠同源物，但DNA结合能力得以保留。然而，在成年TMU的睾丸、肝脏或大脑中未检测到Sry表达。尽管序列完整，但成年组织中Sry表达的完全缺失强烈表明其调控功能丧失。这些发现为该物种中Sry基因的独特进化提供了见解。
